samples: Uttahon sonthi, Uttahon kit, Uttahon kalaka, Uttahon unnat, Uttahon samat, Uttah

lede: Wat Tha Pong accounts for 18 catalogued manuscripts, 1 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Chiang Mai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (78%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (22%). Dated witnesses run 1895–1964 CE (13 of 18 carry a date).
